dimensions.label: State/action/observer contract
dimensions.displayLabel: 状态 / 动作 / 观测契约
evidence: Executable world/action schemas, SHA-256 state digests, deterministic ordinal branch namespaces and transactional rollback.
dimensions.nextAction: Move the runtime into a worker-backed append-only action log.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Fresh worker restoration reproduces state digest, parent chain and ordered actions across 1/5/20 horizons.

dimensions.label: Data and provenance
dimensions.summary: 固定资产已在受保护 Linux 验证；未完成全基准
evidence: Protected-main run 33226521340 produced bounded, label-free ten-record MatterSim and MACE smoke artifacts. R6a runs 33229898921 and 33229901480 failed during container observation. R6b runs 33231316217 and 33231323492 completed all four model jobs, but every locked R5 run summary contradicted its outer non-promotional evidence with nested promotionEligible=true. None is an accepted replica; the count remains 0/2. This R6c Commit-P candidate activates an exact-byte quarantine for that legacy runner and prepositions a recursively non-promotional v2 runner at inert versioned paths; v2 is not selected or executed here.
dimensions.nextAction: Pass Commit P through protected-main Sentinel and obtain its immutable merged SHA; then bind those exact bytes non-circularly from Commit S, execute two entirely fresh protected-main runs, authenticate both with a separately controlled verifier, and freeze accepted identities only in a later Commit F.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: P and S each pass protected-main Sentinel; two fresh S runs produce byte-identical canonical runtime inputs with no positive promotion, comparison or reproduction claim at any nesting depth; a controlled receipt binds both revisions, run and job conclusions, artifact IDs, archive digests and the complete runner identity before F freezes anything.

dimensions.label: Atomistic physics
dimensions.summary: LJ 回归 + 双模型 10 帧隔离 smoke
evidence: Force finite-difference, cutoff continuity, exact pair momentum and 10k-step NVE drift tests; protected-main run 33226521340 passed both isolated ten-record smoke paths. R6b later completed two more dual-model smoke executions, but their positive nested promotion claims make them inadmissible and add no scientific result. The R6c Commit-P candidate now quarantines the conflicting R5 producer and prepositions a v2 producer whose promotion, comparison, reproduction and promotion-trust-root claims are recursively fixed to false; it remains inactive until Commit S.
dimensions.nextAction: Pass Commit P through protected-main Sentinel, then complete Commit S, two entirely fresh negative-claim runtime replicas, controlled verification and later Commit F before executing both models on all 693 Random-TP records.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Energy, force, stress, stability, OOD and cost metrics are reproduced with checkpoint and runner digests.

dimensions.label: Mesoscale
dimensions.nextAction: Implement the pinned NIST PFHub Benchmark 3 coupled phase/heat case.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Free energy, solid fraction, tip position and zero contour meet preregistered PFHub tolerances.

dimensions.label: Continuum fields
dimensions.summary: 面积热容 + 二维二阶收敛
evidence: Area heat-capacity density keeps total heat capacity and pulse energy grid-independent; three two-dimensional Fourier modes converge at observed order at least 1.8 through the production CFL path.
dimensions.nextAction: Implement the pinned NIST PFHub Benchmark 3 phase-field / heat case without weakening the current grid-convergence gates.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: PFHub free energy, solid fraction, tip position and zero contour meet preregistered tolerances while total field energy remains grid-invariant.

dimensions.label: Reactor and process
dimensions.summary: 仅 A→B 标签，非反应器
dimensions.nextAction: Reproduce a pinned Cantera 3.2 CSTR before adding any process recommendation.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Species, temperature and energy trajectories match the locked Cantera reference and close balances below 0.1%.

dimensions.label: Cross-scale coupling
dimensions.summary: 解析交换 + 原子反应结算
evidence: The production path uses an exact two-reservoir kernel verified across 73 cases, fail-closed temperature limits, and an atomic multi-cell A-to-B settlement with independently normalized operator closures.
dimensions.nextAction: Replace hand-set coefficients with a calibrated one-way atomistic-to-field readout for one locked material, then validate held-out transport observables.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Coarse-grid energy and momentum integrals remain invariant, Galilean boosts preserve local temperature, and held-out transport quantities lie inside calibrated intervals.

dimensions.label: Multi-turn world behavior
evidence: Content-disambiguated state/action IDs, complete integrity digests, idempotent branch tokens, full-state serialization and deterministic counter RNG.
dimensions.nextAction: Persist append-only histories and quantify rollout error at 1/5/20 horizons.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: No state collision, ordering ambiguity, NaN or unexplained error growth across locked action sequences.

dimensions.label: Uncertainty and OOD
dimensions.summary: 完整资源域，尚无校准 UQ
evidence: Machine-readable envelopes now cover count, uint32 seed, density, grid occupancy/aspect, cutoff, diffusivity, heat capacity, coupling, kinetics, horizon and exact work budgets; eight-seed tails are gated.
dimensions.nextAction: Separate numerical, parameter and model-form uncertainty, then calibrate atomistic ensemble intervals on held-out structures.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Every supported parameter has a machine-readable envelope and cost limit; locked 90% intervals cover 85–95% in-domain and abstain on preregistered OOD cases.

dimensions.label: Reproducibility and cost
dimensions.summary: 8×5000 经验尾部 + 成本预算
evidence: Eight preregistered seeds run for 5,000 steps with deterministic checkpoint continuation, empirical p50/p95/p99/max summaries, worst-seed reporting and exact pair/heat/reaction work envelopes.
dimensions.nextAction: Run the 32-seed × 10,000-step promotion profile on two clean Linux runners and compare canonical artifacts.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Two clean runners reproduce the manifest and stay inside the preregistered latency envelope.

dimensions.label: Visualization truthfulness
dimensions.summary: 粒子 / 热场 / 账本同帧
evidence: Canvas heat field, particle labels, fixed 20–260 K scale, state ID, ledger and click probe are derived from one observation snapshot; the exact observation can be downloaded.
dimensions.nextAction: Package a signed, immutable replay bundle that binds the observation, action chain and release provenance.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: A clean browser replays the downloaded bundle and reproduces every sampled pixel/cell/particle value under the same release commit and digest.

dimensions.label: Safety, license and governance
dimensions.displayLabel: 安全 / 许可 / 治理
evidence: Visible toy-model boundary, claim lint, pinned package/model/data license catalogs, an explicit fail-closed UMA exclusion, a green-commit Cloudflare release guard, dependency audit and no control-output endpoint.
dimensions.nextAction: Generate a CycloneDX SBOM and freeze the remaining dataset legal bytes and attribution obligations.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Dependency, package, model, dataset and SBOM policy gates pass; unresolved legal bytes abstain and no direct control endpoint exists.
